cover.title: 5 Muscle Growth Apps
cover.subtitle: Loggers track your lifts — but #3 tracks the muscle itself.

apps.description: The cleanest gym logger out there — every set, rep, and PR. But it tracks what you lift, not what your body does with it.

apps.name: JEFIT
apps.description: Pairs solid logging with ready-made routines and strength stats. Powerful, but it still measures the work, not the muscle.
Loggers track the lifts you put in; GainFrame tracks the muscle that comes out — scoring 12 groups from a single photo.

apps.name: Strong
apps.description: Beloved for its no-friction logging and Watch support. Excellent at tracking sets — but that's all it tracks.
Tracks body measurements and photos over time. Closer to the goal than a lift logger, but you do all the measuring by hand.

caption: I ranked 5 apps for tracking muscle gain 💪 Four are brilliant at logging your lifts — the inputs — but #3 is the only one that tracks the actual output: your muscle, scored across 12 groups from a single progress photo. Log your lifts in the others, then check the result in #3. GainFrame is free on iOS. #musclegain #gymtok #fitnessapps #bodybuilding #bodycomposition
